text:
maya: ran a short sweep across ap-southeast1 (singapore) and eu-west1 comparing A100 vs H100 on mosaicl-7b in q8x4 and q4_0 profiles. posting highlights.
perf-bot: job 2026-03-18T02:09:27Z started: bench-3951234567
maya: baseline config: 1x gpu, single-stream prefill then decode, kv-cache cold, mix qbatch=4, microbatch=8 tokens.
maya: H100 median prefill latency: 42ms (eu), 48ms (ap); A100 median prefill: 60ms (eu), 68ms (ap).
sam_k: so ~30% prefill delta in both regions, makes sense given tensor cores and fp8 kernels.
ellis: decode tokens/sec (prefill cached): H100 24k t/s, A100 18k t/s on same batch settings.
ryan: what about p99 tails? that's where customer UX bites.
maya: p99 decode: H100 ~210ms, A100 ~310ms in ap-southeast1 under iso qps; eu-west1 tails smaller but same direction.
ellis: kv cache hit scenario (warm): cost per 1M tokens H100 $9.8, A100 $12.1 (spot discounts + infra price diff here). cold (no cache): H100 $13.5, A100 $15.9.
sam_k: kernel notes: q8x4 uses optimized fused-attn on H100; on A100 we saw a fallthrough to matmul+softmax for >1024 context which kills decode throughput.
maya: interestingly q4_0 on A100 gets closer to H100 at small seq lengths (<512) because quant kernel benefits outweigh kernel fallthrough.
ryan: any thermal/redispatch issues during sustained run?
infra-bot: node 7 (ap-southeast1) reported a 5% throttle window during a 45min sustained run — auto-redispatch triggered at 2026-03-18T02:35:10Z.
ellis: that throttle pushed A100 tail worse; H100 machines didn't throttle in same window.
maya: ops takeaway: for asia customers, H100 gives both latency and $/1M wins for 7b family if you expect low cold-cache hit rates and long contexts. if you have high kv-hit and short seqs, A100 q4_0 can be cost-competitive.
sam_k: can we add a microbatching knob in runtime to push a100 decode parity? maybe increase microbatch to 12 for A100 and measure.
maya: yes adding to next run. also will capture full kernel selection traces and attach later.
perf-bot: job 2026-03-18T02:13:09Z finished: bench-3951234567, artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/bench-3951234567/{summary.csv,kernel-trace.log,regions.json}
ryan: thanks — useful snapshot. can you put a one-liner for the docs channel? :thumbsup:
maya: will do — short blurb and attach graphs (latency CDFs, tokens/sec bar, $/1M table)
